basic_info.description: Welcome to 631 Myra Way, a beautifully renovated single family home nestle in the highly sought-after Miraloma Park neighborhood of San Francisco. This light-filled residence features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms on the main level, with city and water views from the living room, dining area, and kitchen. The lower-level family room/bonus room offers flexible space with excellent potential for additional living area or future expansion.  Thoughtfully updated throughout, the home includes a brand-new kitchen, remodeled bathrooms, new roof, windows, upgraded electrical with new panel, new plumbing, and a freshly landscaped backyard with new fencing. A two-car side-by-side garage completes the home.  Ideally located near Mount Davidson's scenic trails, Glen Canyon Park, Tower Market/Mollie Stone's, and the shops along Portola Street. 631 Myra Way offers a rare opportunity to own a fully renovated home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods
